title: Binary Tree Upside Down
statement: Flip a binary tree whose right children are leaves with left siblings: the original leftmost node becomes root, and each original parent becomes the right child of its original left child.
approach_name: Rewire while descending the left spine
code:
from typing import Optional

class Solution:
    def upsideDownBinaryTree(self, root: Optional[TreeNode]) -> Optional[TreeNode]:
        if not root or not root.left:return root
        new_root=self.upsideDownBinaryTree(root.left)
        root.left.left=root.right;root.left.right=root
        root.left=None;root.right=None
        return new_root

title: Read N Characters Given Read4
statement: Implement read(buf, n) using the judge-provided read4(buf4) API. Read at most n characters into buf and return the count. This solution assumes a single call.
approach_name: Repeatedly read chunks until n or EOF
code:
from typing import List

class Solution:
    def read(self, buf: List[str], n: int) -> int:
        total=0;tmp=['']*4
        while total<n:
            count=read4(tmp)
            if count==0:break
            take=min(count,n-total)
            for i in range(take):buf[total+i]=tmp[i]
            total+=take
            if count<4:break
        return total
